Turbo PDF: Scanner & Editor is a highly reliable scanner application that effectively transforms your smartphone into a robust PDF scanner. This application enables seamless conversion of photos and pictures into PDF format with a simple and convenient touch function. 

Features of the Turbo PDF: Scanner & Editor
Scan your documents, crop image sizes.
Convert images to PDF format.
Convert pdf to other formats.
Efficient and user-friendly scanning experience with a quick and convenient interface.
Share documents via social media, add watermark.
File encryption to protect your privacy.

By using our app you can seamlessly convert photos and documents to PDF, or convert pdf to other file formats. Turbo PDF: Scanner & Editor is the premier PDF converter that makes working with scanned documents extremely easy.
